page.overview:
Who is Dunma?

When gets carried away speaking to , will interrupt to remind him that they are on duty. Since it is their first time meeting, she introduce herself to . If asks if she is female, comments on how observant he is.

After has been calmed, tells that it has been some time since has seen the sun. She wonders if the has stopped spouting water. Once has received the , calls him no ordinary man and proclaims that he will always be welcome in .
